abstract: BACKGROUND: Chemorefractory metastatic germ cell tumors and elevated tumor markers generally indicate inoperable disease. METHODS: Solitary metastases were resected in 15 patients who had a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and an elevated alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and/or human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) serum level after treatment with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Patients underwent resection for a residual mass after chemotherapy or for a new solitary metastasis after achieving a complete response (CR) to salvage chemotherapy. RESULTS: Seven patients were disease-free after surgical resection alone. All five patients with an elevated HCG level had a relapse after surgery compared with 3 of 10 patients with only an elevated AFP level. Only 4 of 10 patients with a retroperitoneal metastasis had a relapse after surgery compared with 4 of 5 patients with visceral disease. Eleven of 15 patients overall were disease-free after surgery and subsequent chemotherapy after a relapse. CONCLUSIONS: Surgical resection of a solitary metastasis despite elevated serum tumor markers should be considered in patients who have not had a durable CR to cisplatin-based chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 化学療法後に孤立性転移を切除。背景:化学療抵抗性の転移性胚細胞腫瘍と腫瘍マーカー高値は、通常は切除不能病変を示す。方法:シスプラチン併用化学療法後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)および/またはヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の血清値が高値であった非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者15例で、孤立性転移を切除した。残存腫瘤の切除、または救援化学療法後に完全奏効を得た新規孤立性転移の切除を受けた。結果:7例は手術のみで無病であった。hCG高値の5例は全例が術後に再発した。AFPのみ高値の10例では3例が再発した。後腹膜転移の10例では4例が術後に再発し、内臓病変の5例では4例が再発した。全体では15例中11例が、再発後の手術と化学療法の後に無病であった。結論:シスプラチン併用化学療法に持続的な完全奏効が得られなかった患者では、腫瘍マーカーが高値であっても孤立性転移の切除を考慮すべきである。
